standard.summary: 按指定比例合并多个 Stable Diffusion
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Merges several Stable Diffusion models at the given ratios
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 按指定比例合并多个 Stable Diffusion 模型。多个模型/比例用空格分隔。

advanced_en.principle: Merges multiple Stable Diffusion models at specified ratios. Separate multiple model/ratio pairs with spaces.
